views.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. This is a registration repair of an educational anatomy layer. Image1 ORIGINAL ULTRASOUND is the edit target and exact geometry authority on the 1280x880 canvas. Image2 is ONLY the existing approved Kansei tissue material/style reference; do NOT copy its displaced contours. Image3 is the ORIGINAL scan with clinically supplied finding outline: those positions must be preserved. Return ONE full-frame painting matching original composition and proportions, black outside the original scan. No crop/recenter, no new pathology, no magnification of the abnormality, no generic textbook substitution. Paint skin/fat/fascia/tendon/muscle/bone continuously inside the scan: delicate organic ivory collagen and intramuscular fascia, fine brick-red muscle fascicles, golden irregular fat lobules, thin ivory cortex, small irregular tan trabeculae fading to black below accessible cortex. Dark navy smooth fluid, gray-blue cartilage as appropriate. Preserve existing visible morphology without assigning diagnoses. No machine header, numbers, labels, arrows, measurement calipers, colored outlines or text in final; they are separate code layers. Deep tissue fades to black, not leftover grayscale islands. No triangle mesh, no tiled texture, no ruler-straight fibers. Whole painting only. Exact contour anchors below refer to ORIGINAL1280x880 and must not drift. Original scan rectangle x108..1170,y31..810. Most important: LEFT bony prominence roof follows (447,319)→(469,292)→(495,279)→(521,260)→(543,267)→(562,304). The left marked prominence occupies x449..576,y261..387. Its peak MUST stay at(520,262), not(550,250). RIGHT bony prominence roof follows(675,328)→(677,309)→(696,305)→(711,298)→(732,307)→(751,317)→(762,344), with region x683..763,y305..397. Do NOT shift it to x744..802 as image2 did. Central meniscal triangle lies between original bones with tip near(627,418). The broad MCL follows original arched bright band above meniscus and bone, not a newly taller arch. Preserve black fluid pockets lateral to those edges as in original. No oversized new osteophytes. Bone outer cortex and superficial interfaces must retain source positions; the clinically marked outlines in image3 should trace the NEW painting's contours exactly.
